name: App simulation concept-proof receipt and badge binding
target: Replays declared app.yaml simulations into a persisted proof receipt and serves an owned attribution badge only when every required scenario passes against the current source fingerprint with measured sandbox evidence.
inputs: deterministic simulated runner outcomes and network evidence
current app source fingerprint and existing app-simulation-db store
hosted app HTML including malformed raw-text and script-escaped examples
observations: required scenario names come from app.yaml rather than caller input
simulation events, receipt and concept proof commit atomically
stale, failed, missing and unmeasured evidence never shows the owned badge
browser-parsed owned footer receives exactly the current proof fingerprint
